facts.text: The hotel's interiors are by Jacques Garcia, in a Belle Epoque-inspired style that recalls 19th-century Paris.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is a haven of Belle Époque-inspired elegance, where sumptuous interiors by Jacques Garcia recall the bygone glamor of 19th-century Paris.

facts.text: The hotel is a boutique hotel in Seoul's Myeongdong neighborhood, near N Seoul Tower, Namdaemun Market and Deoksu-gung Palace.
facts.excerpt: is near many leading attractions, including N Seoul Tower, Namdaemun Market, and Deoksu-gung Palace.

facts.text: Rooms blend Belle Epoque charm with modern-day comfort.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in luxury Myeongdong, Seoul hotel rooms​ blending Belle Époque charm with modern-day comfort

facts.text: The top three suite categories feature a mini kitchen, suited to longer stays.

facts.text: L'Amant Secret, led by Executive Chef Jongwon Son, is a Michelin-starred French fine-dining restaurant on the 26th floor with views.
facts.excerpt: Led by Executive Chef Jongwon Son, our Michelin-star restaurant in Myeongdong, Seoul represents the height of French fine dining. Located on the 26th floor, L'Amant Secret combines exquisite gastronomy and superb wines with spectacular views.

facts.text: Palais de Chine offers an inspired take on 1930s Shanghai cuisine and is featured in the Michelin Guide.
facts.excerpt: Palais de Chine offers an inspired take on the cuisine of 1930s Shanghai in a highly glamorous setting. Featured in the Michelin Guide

facts.text: Marque d'Amour is a high-rise cocktail bar where guests can watch the sunset over creative cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Admire breathtaking sunsets whilst savoring creative cocktails made by our expert mixologists.

facts.text: The Tea Salon, inspired by the salons of France, serves coffee, tea and desserts.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the salons of France where art and culture freely intermingled, Tea Salon presents you relaxation with a cup of coffee, tea, and desserts.

facts.text: The Swiss Perfection Spa has two treatment rooms and offers bespoke beauty and wellness treatments using Swiss Perfection products.
facts.excerpt: a tranquil sanctuary of relaxation and rejuvenation with two exclusive treatment rooms. Bespoke beauty and wellness treatments combine advanced Swiss technology with indulgent Swiss Perfection products.

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24/7.
facts.excerpt: Open 24/7, our Fitness Center offers state-of-the-art equipment.

facts.text: La Maison Boutique is the hotel's club lounge, with breakfast, Sweet Delight and a curated happy hour.
facts.excerpt: Discover L’Escape’s signature boutique spaces. Enjoy refined service, an exquisite breakfast, Sweet Delight, and a curated happy hour.
